name: io.github.knaisoma/data-olympus
title: Data Olympus
description: Governance-grade knowledge-base format (OKF-compatible) plus CLI and single-writer MCP server

environmentVariables.name: KB_MAIN_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the git-backed knowledge bundle this server indexes and serves.

environmentVariables.name: KB_INDEX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the generated SQLite index. Rebuilt atomically and swapped in.

environmentVariables.name: KB_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the streamable HTTP MCP server listens on. Defaults to 8080.
